purpose: Teach: 運河/レントゲン/怪物/満月/種族/蟹/椿/ほのぼの

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと運河沿いを歩いたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I used to walk with your father along the canal.
lines.style: Soft, distant gaze inward. Opens on a remembered moment. Gentle pace, like handling something fragile. Slight warmth underneath the reflection.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、レントゲン検査でお身体を診て頂いたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, dear — your grandfather had an X-ray done, didn't he, for his checkup?
lines.style: Tender, slightly uncertain. Reaching back into her own memory, checking herself. Warm but a little adrift. The 'dear' lands gently, like she's grounding herself in the present moment.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんと孫と怪物映画を観た
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, I watched monster movies with your father and the grandchildren.
lines.style: Opens with the same wistful pull as before. A flicker of lightness on the memory of watching together. Still slow, still held in the past tense of the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、満月の日に詩を詠まれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather wrote poetry on full-moon nights, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, searching slightly. Like she's naming something beautiful she half-remembers. Soft falling at the end. The affection in 'dear' is certain, even if the memory isn't.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは異種族との交流を大事にされた
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father valued his friendships with people very different from us.
lines.style: Thoughtful and measured. A note of quiet pride underneath. Slower on this one — the idea carries weight. Delivered like a small lesson he's held onto.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お祝いに蟹のお料理を作って下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather cooked crab for us on special occasions, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender warmth with a small smile in the voice. Remembering something concrete and loving. The 'dear' lands with affection this time, more settled. Gentle trailing fade.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは庭に椿を植えられたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when I was young, your father planted camellias in the garden.
lines.style: Softest of all. Like placing something down carefully. The past tense is almost reverent. Quiet, barely a whisper of breath. The image blooms in the silence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様とほのぼのと過ごされたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather spent such peaceful, gentle time with the grandchildren, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Tender, warm, almost glowing. The memory has solidified into something beautiful. Soft vocal closure. 'Dear' is now full recognition — of him, of the time, of what matters.
